title: Rename stale test store_fails_closed_when_exactly_one_side_is_present
description: Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml. announce_store.rs:466: since the s6ml fix, the second half of this test (:488-494) asserts the OPPOSITE of fail-closed for (Some, None) - it asserts load heals the floor forward. Assertions are correct; only the name misdescribes the now-asymmetric contract (missing state fails closed, missing floor heals). Rename to reflect the asymmetric contract, e.g. store_fails_closed_on_missing_state_and_heals_missing_floor.
